description: Applies to up to 10 brands' programs at once from the creator profile, and tracks each. How each one goes depends on the brand: a network (Impact, Awin, Shopify Collabs…) or the brand's form opens with the answers ready to paste; an email program comes back as a draft (mailto) for the creator's own mail, from the address brand replies are read at. Nothing is sent by Chockstone. The address is never part of an application. A space with no room for more applications this month says so (LIMIT_REACHED). Agents get a confirm_token step.

confirm_token.description: Token from a CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED response, sent after the user confirms.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: brand_program_apply
title: Apply to brand programs
